definition: Study area identifier: community area number (1-77) or Census place GEOID.
source: Chicago Health Atlas community areas; Cook County Health Atlas places (Metopio)
interpretation: Join key. Not a number to analyse.

definition: Community area or municipality name.
source: Chicago Health Atlas community areas; Cook County Health Atlas places (Metopio)
interpretation: Label.

definition: 'Chicago, IL' or 'suburban Cook County'.
source: Chicago Health Atlas community areas; Cook County Health Atlas places (Metopio)
interpretation: Use to stratify Chicago vs suburban areas.

definition: 'community area' or 'municipality'.
source: Chicago Health Atlas community areas; Cook County Health Atlas places (Metopio)
interpretation: Also identifies the group each ADI score is relative to.

definition: Total population (ACS B01003_001). Community areas: sum of tracts whose interior point falls in the area.
interpretation: Denominator for per-capita rates. Margins of error are not carried through.

definition: Polygon area in square miles, land and water, from EPSG:3435.
interpretation: Denominator for densities. Lakefront areas include some water.

definition: Area Deprivation Index: factor-based composite of the 15 indicators below, scaled to mean 100, SD 20.
interpretation: Higher = more socioeconomic disadvantage. Relative to areas of the same type (community areas or municipalities) only.

definition: ADI-3 subscale: income, housing costs and white-collar jobs.
interpretation: Higher = more financial strength (less disadvantage). Relative to areas of the same type (community areas or municipalities) only.

definition: ADI-3 subscale: poverty, renting, income inequality, single parents, no vehicle, unemployment.
interpretation: Higher = more hardship. Relative to areas of the same type (community areas or municipalities) only.

definition: ADI-3 subscale: education levels and household crowding.
interpretation: Higher = more educational attainment (less disadvantage). Relative to areas of the same type (community areas or municipalities) only.

definition: Median family income, US dollars (B19113).
interpretation: Higher = less disadvantage. Community areas: population-weighted mean of tract medians.

definition: Median monthly owner costs for housing units with a mortgage, US dollars (B25088).
interpretation: Higher = less disadvantage. Community areas: population-weighted mean of tract medians.

definition: Median gross rent, US dollars (B25064).
interpretation: Higher = less disadvantage. Community areas: population-weighted mean of tract medians.

definition: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, US dollars (B25077).
interpretation: Higher = less disadvantage. Community areas: population-weighted mean of tract medians.

definition: Proportion of families below the poverty level (B17010).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied (B25003).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = less disadvantage.

definition: Log of 100 x (households with income under $10k / households with income of $50k or more) (B19001).
interpretation: Log scale. Higher = more income disparity.

definition: Proportion of people with income below 150% of the federal poverty level (C17002).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of households with children under 18 that are single-parent households (B11005).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of occupied housing units with no vehicle available (B25044).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage; also a marker of reliance on walking and transit.

definition: Proportion of employed people 16+ in management, business, science and arts occupations (C24010).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = less disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of the civilian labor force that is unemployed (B23025).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of people 25+ with at least a high school diploma or equivalent (B15003).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = less disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of people 25+ with less than 9th grade education (B15003).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more disadvantage.

definition: Proportion of occupied housing units with more than one occupant per room (B25014).
interpretation: Proportion 0-1. Higher = more crowding / disadvantage.

definition: Number of street intersections: drive-network nodes merged with osmnx consolidate_intersections(), dead ends excluded.
interpretation: Divide by area_sqmi for intersection density (street connectivity), or use as the denominator for crash rates per intersection.

definition: Number of crashes, 2022-2024, whose first crash type was Pedestrian, all severities.
interpretation: Count, not a rate: normalise by total_population, area_sqmi or intersections. Includes the fatal crashes counted in ped_fatalities.

definition: Number of fatal crashes, 2022-2024, whose first harmful event was a pedestrian (one record per crash).
interpretation: Counts crashes, not deaths; a crash can kill more than one person. Small numbers: pool years or areas for stable rates.

definition: MarketScore: supermarkets within a 30-minute walk of the subzone centroid.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Chicago State University, 2011
interpretation: -10 (none) to 10 (7+). Negative values flag areas without a supermarket in reach.

definition: Public libraries within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Illinois State Library, 2010

definition: SchoolsScore: public and private schools within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Illinois State Board of Education, 2013

definition: Metra stations within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | RTA, 2013
interpretation: 0 (none) to 10 (7+). Mostly suburban.

definition: Pace bus stops within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Pace, 2015
interpretation: 0 (none) to 2 (5+).

definition: CTA rail stations within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | CTA, 2015
interpretation: 0 (none) to 20 (5+). Mostly Chicago and inner suburbs.

definition: Selected destinations (restaurants, shops, arts, public administration; NAICS list in the methodology) within a 30-minute walk.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Dun & Bradstreet, 2015

definition: Total amenity score: sum of the amenity scores above.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area
interpretation: Methodology range -10 to 92 (including transit access). Higher = more destinations within walking distance. Contains no crash data.

definition: ParcelScore: average parcel size in the subzone.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | county assessor files, 2014-2016
interpretation: 0 (10,000+ sq ft) to 20 (<5,000 sq ft). Smaller parcels = finer-grained, more varied development.

definition: Jobs in the subzone, scored only where the subzone has 100+ households.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | CMAP 2010 subzone employment estimates
interpretation: 0 or 10 (200+ jobs). Rewards mixed residential and employment use.

definition: B_LENGscore: average block length in the walkshed.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Navteq streets, 2015
interpretation: 5 if under 500 ft, else 0. Shorter blocks = more direct walking routes.

definition: INT_DENSscore: density of 4-way intersections in the walkshed.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Navteq streets, 2015
interpretation: 0 (<40/sq mi), 10 (40-70) or 20 (>70). Higher = better connected grid.

definition: B_SIZEscore: average block size in the walkshed, acres.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | Navteq streets, 2015
interpretation: 10 if 1-9 acres, else 0.

definition: Ratio of tree canopy to road density, for subzones with at least 1 mile of road.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | University of Vermont urban tree canopy
interpretation: 0 to 2 in the scoring table (summary table lists 3). Higher = more shade and comfort.

definition: SerFatalScore: penalty for serious and fatal bicycle and pedestrian crashes, scaled by subzone population.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | IDOT crashes, 2010-2014
interpretation: 0 to -6; harsher where population is under 1,000. Overlaps with crash outcomes; see notes above.

definition: TransitAccess: CMAP Access to Transit Index score for transit connectivity and frequency.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area | CMAP Access to Transit Index, 2013
interpretation: 0 to 10. Higher = better transit service.

definition: Total characteristics score: sum of ParcelScor through SerFatalSc.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area
interpretation: Methodology range -41 to 88. Includes crash penalties.

definition: Total walkability score: Amenities + Character.
source: CMAP Walkability Local Strategy Map (subzone09); area-weighted to study area
interpretation: Possible -51 to 180; observed -43.5 to 156. CMAP classes: 0 or less very low, 1-20 low, 21-50 moderate, 51-100 high, 101+ very high. Includes crash penalties.
